diagnosis: The LangChain DynamicStructuredTool lookup handler executes with user-supplied tool arguments and queries the Invoice model directly by invoiceId. Because the tool execution context does not receive or enforce the authenticated user's organizationId, an attacker prompting the AI tool execution endpoint can specify arbitrary invoice IDs to extract proprietary billing records, line items, and customer tax identifiers belonging to other corporate accounts.
